findings.claim: The merge gate disagrees with the hard rule. The Hard Rule says a merge needs `gh pr checks` showing no failing line. The Decision Gate also stops on a pending line. An agent or owner reading only one of the two gets different merge conditions, and the test only checks for the phrase 'no failing line'.
The adjacent, earlier CHANGELOG entry still says `branch-pr` is unchanged. This commit rewrites it, so the two entries now contradict each other.

evidence: Read the whole diff. The branch-pr skill text, the manifest row, the registry row, the lint baseline list and its pinned size (16 to 15) are consistent with one another.

The new tests' required phrases (`only on an owner message that asks for`, `exited 0`, `closing entry`, `no failing line`, both regexes, `Risk:`, `Co-Authored-By`) all appear in the new SKILL.md body.
None of the banned strings appear in the new SKILL.md.
